scripts.build:css: npx tailwindcss -i ./wwwroot/css/tailwind.src.css -o ./wwwroot/css/tailwind.min.css --minify && node -e "const fs=require('fs');let c=fs.readFileSync('./wwwroot/css/app-portal.css','utf8').replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g,'').replace(/\s*([{}:;,>~+=])\s*/g,'$1').replace(/[\r\n\f]+/g,'').replace(/\s{2,}/g,' ').replace(/;\}/g,'}').trim();fs.writeFileSync('./wwwroot/css/app-portal.min.css',c);console.log('✓ app-portal.min.css built')"
scripts.watch:css: npx tailwindcss -i ./wwwroot/css/tailwind.src.css -o ./wwwroot/css/tailwind.min.css --watch & node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='./wwwroot/css/app-portal.css',dst='./wwwroot/css/app-portal.min.css';const m=()=>{let c=fs.readFileSync(src,'utf8').replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g,'').replace(/\s*([{}:;,>~+=])\s*/g,'$1').replace(/[\r\n\f]+/g,'').replace(/\s{2,}/g,' ').replace(/;\}/g,'}').trim();fs.writeFileSync(dst,c);console.log('✓ app-portal.min.css rebuilt')};m();fs.watch(src,m);console.log('Watching app-portal.css...')"
